en: Chapter on the Determination of Formless Phenomena,
Section 4: The Question on the Brahma World.
"Venerable Nāgasena, how far from here is the Brahma-world?

"It is far, Great King, from here to the Brahma-world. A stone the size of a gabled house, if dropped from there, would take four months to reach the earth, falling at a rate of forty-eight thousand yojanas per day and night."

‘Just as a strong man might stretch out his bent arm or bend his stretched arm, even so a bhikkhu possessing psychic power who has attained mastery over his mind, having vanished from Jambudīpa, would appear in the Brahma-world. I do not believe this statement, for how could he travel so many hundreds of yojanas so very swiftly?”
The Elder asked, “But where, Great King, is your birthplace?
“Venerable sir, there is an island named Alasanda; it is there that I was born.”
“How far away, Great King, is Alexandria from here?
“Do you recall, Great King, having ever gone there and performed some business while traveling?”
“You have indeed traveled quickly, Great King, for you have gone two hundred leagues in just two measures of time.
The Fourth Question: On the Brahma-world.
